opening.argument: The segment is a conventional CBS news interview focused on reported business expansion and public affairs, not an offer or financial solicitation. It reports that JPMorgan Chase planned to open new branches and hire workers, describing the effort as part of an investment supporting regional economic growth. The format is explicitly journalistic: “CBS Evening News anchor Jeff Gloor spoke with chairman and CEO Jamie Dimon about JPMorgan Chase, President Trump, immigration immigration and a whole lot more.” The frame likewise shows two suited men in an interview setting with a CBS This Morning lower-third. Nothing presented asks viewers to invest, pay money, provide private information, or join a financial opportunity; references to following or subscribing are ordinary engagement with CBS programming.

citations.quote: JPMorgan Chase announced plans yesterday to open 70 new branches and hire 700 workers in Washington, D.C., Virginia, and Maryland.
CBS Evening News anchor Jeff Gloor spoke with chairman and CEO Jamie Dimon about JPMorgan Chase, President Trump, immigration immigration and a whole lot more.
